intent: Turn inspection into a continuous three-beat consequence sequence: finding, field pushback, and reinspection verdict.

stages.purpose: show the operational cost or dependency created by that response
test the claim against the actual field condition and turn it into a visible verdict

presentation_rules: Keep the same 10:16→10:24→10:39 timeline visible across the aftermath.
Do not label any route as the correct answer; expose its tradeoff and what the reinspection actually verifies.
When inspection_result is written, update the same panel from verification focus to field verdict.
